content: BlockingScheduler suits a standalone worker process where the scheduler is the only thing running (start() blocks forever) -- fits a dedicated ingestion worker script. BackgroundScheduler runs on a thread inside a larger app (e.g. alongside Flask) and start() returns immediately. Register SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers calling scheduler.shutdown(wait=True/False) for graceful container shutdown; atexit does not fire on SIGKILL.
